create.name: Frida Möhres
create.bio:
Frida Möhres is a gong player and teacher who first met the instrument during a yoga class in Buenos Aires in 2015 and has worked with it ever since. She trained with the gong master Don Conreaux, taking part in his first gong teacher training in Slovenia in 2019, and in 2023 gained accreditation to teach Flumie playing, a friction-mallet style developed by Bear of Bear Love Sacred Sound. Her path into sound was not a straight line: she studied business in Berlin and interior design in Argentina, and has since qualified as a yoga teacher, mindfulness trainer and feng shui consultant, interests that shape how she sets up a room and a session.

The heart of her work is a small-group course in Berlin, spread over two weekends, that shows beginners how to play gong baths for themselves and for others. Alongside it she runs a one-day Flumie workshop, a self-paced online introduction to Flumies, and a yoga and sound weekend in Brandenburg with a yoga teacher, Lisa of Feel Yoga. Her recorded gong meditations are free to hear on her YouTube channel and on Insight Timer. She now lives in Barcelona and teaches in German, English and Spanish, in person and online.

courses.title: Initiation into Gong Playing Training Berlin
courses.description: A 30-hour beginners' training over two weekends in Berlin for a small group of four to eight, teaching how to play gong baths for yourself and others. Instruments and worksheets are provided, and a hybrid option starts the first part one to one online.

courses.title: Introduction to Flumies
courses.description: A self-paced online video course on playing a gong with Flumies, the friction mallets that draw long, smooth tones. It covers how to hold them, the different sizes and models, care of the mallets and a few warm-up exercises, with lifetime access.

courses.title: Flumie Level 1 Training
courses.description: A one-day, hands-on workshop in Berlin on the basics of Flumie gong playing, taught to the curriculum of Bear of Bear Love Sacred Sound. It is for personal practice rather than teaching; new English dates are still to be announced.

courses.title: Klang deines Seins: Yoga & Sound Retreat
courses.description: A German-language weekend at a lakeside spa hotel in Brandenburg, co-led with yoga teacher Lisa of Feel Yoga. It mixes gentle hatha and yin yoga with gong and sound baths, opening and closing rituals and time in the spa.

free_resources.title: Frida Möhres on Insight Timer
free_resources.description: Recorded gong sound baths and gong meditations by Frida, free to hear in the Insight Timer app or on the web.

free_resources.title: Guided Gong Meditations
free_resources.description: A page on Frida's site gathering her free gong meditations, in video and audio, on themes such as focus and self-love. Most run about half an hour and are best heard lying down with headphones.
